findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 163 requests to 34 third-party domains (median of 2 passes).
Of 15.2 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 5.7 MB (37%) came from third-party domains, 1.1 MB of it from services classified as tracking (56 requests).

17 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising), amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), casalemedia.com (Index Exchange, advertising), doubleclick.net (Google, advertising), doubleverify.com (DoubleVerify, advertising), fwmrm.net (FreeWheel, advertising), googlesyndication.com (Google, advertising), kargo.com (Kargo, advertising), openx.net (OpenX, advertising).
9 cookies were set by third-party domains (49 cookies in total).

With the EasyPrivacy filter list applied (domain rules only, 47222 rules), 30 requests were blocked. The page still made 163 requests to 34 third-party domains, including 17 tracking services in our list.
